criativos.title: "I never leave home without this" [92878]
criativos.bodyText:
I’m not a full blown prepper but I DO want to keep my family safe if things start hitting the fan. This little orange bag was the first step I took - and it’s already saved my bacon multiple times, it’s a surprisingly compact but warm survival tool and I can’t imagine not having one in my glove box at this point.

Yes…. It's a full size adult sleeping bag that fits in your pocket. It weighs just a few ounces. It’s waterproof and windproof. It can protect your entire body. It can keep you from hypothermia, shock, or freezing to death. 

I bought 20 of them. 

Everyone in my family now has one and we replenished all the ones we gave away last hurricane. 

So I know my family, friends, and neighbors have a fighting chance when disaster strikes AND we’ll still be able to help those around us.  

Get your family ready by grabbing a few of these here: https://offer.sierramadreresearch.com/emergency-sleeping-bag-special-offer 

My family loves them and we’ve used them in normal everyday life, like at a soccer game in the dead of winter - or on our last road trip where we got stuck on top of a mountain pass. 

In my opinion this is the single most important tool that everyone should have in place for their family.

criativos.title: "I never leave home without this" [79411]
criativos.bodyText:
Admittedly we don’t live in the city for this very reason - a grid failure in a highly populated area would be catastrophic and turn into utter chaos. In the suburbs and the country we won’t be hit nearly as hard by the chaos in the city, but let’s face it - we’ve become pretty dependent on energy. Our biggest struggle, even in mild climates, will be keeping warm. Texas had this problem a few years back - people literally freezing to death inside their homes because the grid went down. 

Hide a few of these tiny orange bags in your home and your loved ones homes - it will keep you and your loved ones warm when all else fails. 

What I love about it is how small and lightweight it is, so it’s not in the way, but it’s there when you need it. 

The really unbelievable thing the Emergency Sleeping Bag does is reflect your heat and keep you warm down to arctic temperatures. 

Yes… It fits in your pocket. It weighs just a few ounces. It’s waterproof. It can protect your entire body. It can keep you from hypothermia, shock, or freezing to death. 

I bought 20 of them. 

Everyone in my family now has one. 

This way I know that if they go on a hike and they get stranded in the middle of nowhere - they’ll have protection and warmth. Or if their car breaks down without a cell signal, you at least know they can keep themselves and family warm and protected. 

I would have thought these things should be $100 at least, but fortunately they are affordable - especially with this sale that’s going on right now. 

Get your family ready by grabbing a few of these here: https://offer.sierramadreresearch.com/emergency-sleeping-bag-special-offer 

My family loves them and we’ve used them in normal everyday life, like at a soccer game in the dead of winter - or on our last road trip where we got stuck on top of a mountain pass. 

In my opinion this is the single most important tool that you should have for your family. 
We travel a lot with our kids and after one crazy disaster, I learned a very important lesson. ALWAYS have one of these tiny orange bags in our glove box!
